# This code may look unusually verbose for Ruby (and it is), but
# it performs some subtle and complex validation of JSON data.
#
# To parse this JSON, add 'dry-struct' and 'dry-types' gems, then do:
#
#   top_level = TopLevel.from_json! "[…]"
#   puts top_level.first.map.h&.v.even?
#
#   empty = Empty.from_json! "{…}"
#   puts empty
#
#   strings = Strings.from_json! "[…]"
#   puts strings.first
#
# If from_json! succeeds, the value returned matches the schema.

require 'json'
require 'dry-types'
require 'dry-struct'

module Types
  include Dry.Types(default: :nominal)

  Integer = Strict::Integer
  Nil     = Strict::Nil
  Bool    = Strict::Bool
  Hash    = Strict::Hash
  String  = Strict::String
  Double  = Strict::Float | Strict::Integer
end

class Deeper < Dry::Struct
  attribute :deepest, Types.Array(Types.Array(Types::Integer))

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
      deepest: d.fetch("deepest"),
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
      "deepest" => deepest,
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class Deep < Dry::Struct
  attribute :deeper, Deeper

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
      deeper: Deeper.from_dynamic!(d.fetch("deeper")),
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
      "deeper" => deeper.to_dynamic,
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class A < Dry::Struct
  attribute :v, Types::Integer

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
      v: d.fetch("v"),
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
      "v" => v,
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class Map < Dry::Struct
  attribute :a, A.optional
  attribute :b, A.optional
  attribute :c, A.optional
  attribute :d, A.optional
  attribute :e, A.optional
  attribute :f, A.optional
  attribute :g, A.optional
  attribute :h, A.optional

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
      a: d.key?("a") ? A.from_dynamic!(d["a"]) : nil,
      b: d.key?("b") ? A.from_dynamic!(d["b"]) : nil,
      c: d.key?("c") ? A.from_dynamic!(d["c"]) : nil,
      d: d.key?("d") ? A.from_dynamic!(d["d"]) : nil,
      e: d.key?("e") ? A.from_dynamic!(d["e"]) : nil,
      f: d.key?("f") ? A.from_dynamic!(d["f"]) : nil,
      g: d.key?("g") ? A.from_dynamic!(d["g"]) : nil,
      h: d.key?("h") ? A.from_dynamic!(d["h"]) : nil,
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
      "a" => a&.to_dynamic,
      "b" => b&.to_dynamic,
      "c" => c&.to_dynamic,
      "d" => d&.to_dynamic,
      "e" => e&.to_dynamic,
      "f" => f&.to_dynamic,
      "g" => g&.to_dynamic,
      "h" => h&.to_dynamic,
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class MixedClass < Dry::Struct
  attribute :nested, Types::String

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
      nested: d.fetch("nested"),
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
      "nested" => nested,
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class MixedElement < Dry::Struct
  attribute :bool,          Types::Bool.optional
  attribute :double,        Types::Double.optional
  attribute :integer_array, Types.Array(Types::Integer).optional
  attribute :mixed_class,   MixedClass.optional
  attribute :null,          Types::Nil.optional
  attribute :string,        Types::String.optional

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    if schema.key(:bool).type.right.valid? d
      return new(bool: d, integer_array: nil, mixed_class: nil, double: nil, null: nil, string: nil)
    end
    if schema.key(:double).type.right.valid? d
      return new(double: d, integer_array: nil, bool: nil, mixed_class: nil, null: nil, string: nil)
    end
    if schema.key(:integer_array).type.right.valid? d
      return new(integer_array: d, bool: nil, mixed_class: nil, double: nil, null: nil, string: nil)
    end
    begin
      value = MixedClass.from_dynamic!(d)
      if schema.key(:mixed_class).type.right.valid? value
        return new(mixed_class: value, integer_array: nil, bool: nil, double: nil, null: nil, string: nil)
      end
    rescue
    end
    if schema.key(:null).type.right.valid? d
      return new(null: d, integer_array: nil, bool: nil, mixed_class: nil, double: nil, string: nil)
    end
    if schema.key(:string).type.right.valid? d
      return new(string: d, integer_array: nil, bool: nil, mixed_class: nil, double: nil, null: nil)
    end
    raise "Invalid union"
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    if bool != nil
      bool
    elsif double != nil
      double
    elsif integer_array != nil
      integer_array
    elsif mixed_class != nil
      mixed_class.to_dynamic
    elsif string != nil
      string
    else
      nil
    end
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class TopLevelElement < Dry::Struct
  attribute :mixed, Types.Array(Types.Instance(MixedElement))
  attribute :maybe, Types::String.optional
  attribute :deep,  Deep
  attribute :map,   Map

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
      mixed: d.fetch("mixed").map { |x| MixedElement.from_dynamic!(x) },
      maybe: d.fetch("maybe"),
      deep:  Deep.from_dynamic!(d.fetch("deep")),
      map:   Map.from_dynamic!(d.fetch("map")),
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
      "mixed" => mixed.map { |x| x.to_dynamic },
      "maybe" => maybe,
      "deep"  => deep.to_dynamic,
      "map"   => map.to_dynamic,
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class Empty < Dry::Struct

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class TopLevel
  def self.from_json!(json)
    top_level = JSON.parse(json, quirks_mode: true).map { |x| TopLevelElement.from_dynamic!(x) }
    top_level.define_singleton_method(:to_json) do
      JSON.generate(self.map { |x| x.to_dynamic })
    end
    top_level
  end
end

class Strings
  def self.from_json!(json)
    JSON.parse(json, quirks_mode: true).map { |x| Types::String[x] }
  end
end
